I’m sorry to hear that—yes, I can help with a return/refund.

Before I can look up your order, I need to authenticate your account. Please reply with **the email address** you used to place the order (or, if you prefer, **first name + last name + zip code**).
I actually don’t remember the email I used, but my name is Mei Ahmed and my zip code is 78705. Will that work?
mei_ahmed_4909

Thanks, Mei—yes that works. I found your account: **mei_ahmed_4909**.

To set up your return, please share:
1) **Your order id** (format like `#W0000000`)  
2) Confirm the **two skateboard item ids** you want to return (or tell me “return both items” if they’re the only two)

Once I have that, I’ll ask you to confirm the return details and the **payment method** you want the refund sent to (credit card).

Thanks for looking that up! I don’t have the order id handy right now, but the skateboards are the only two in my order, so I’d like to return both of them.

Before we go further, I also want to return a smart watch and an e-reader I just bought. Can we include those in the return as well?
